counts.name: register_decisions
counts.definition: Every decision in the canonical register: decisions raised by accepted F1/F2 deliveries, cross-batch decisions of the current consolidation record, and decisions the runtime derives (one review decision per item that is not independently verified, one scope decision per program whose classification needs one, one review decision per gap no decision or requirement addresses).
counts.method: buildRegister(snapshot); one entry per decision ID
counts.can_overlap: no (IDs are unique); several decisions may share one root cause

counts.name: blocking_unresolved_decisions
counts.definition: Register decisions with blocking=true whose current resolution status is not resolved (open, stale or untrusted). A property of the whole register, independent of any scope.

counts.name: scope_blocking_findings
counts.definition: Findings of scope application with blocking=true. One finding per evaluated subject: item (requirement, runtime requirement, file-operation set, data record), canonical rule, applicable non-item decision, recorded contradiction, coverage gap, unaccounted packet, unresolved dependency. A derived item-review decision is represented by its item finding, not counted twice.
counts.can_overlap: one subject per finding; one root cause can produce many findings

counts.name: requires_evidence_findings
counts.definition: Findings whose outcome is REQUIRES_EVIDENCE, blocking or not (unresolved dependencies that a gap or decision already tracks are REQUIRES_EVIDENCE but not blocking).

counts.name: contradicted_findings
counts.definition: Findings whose outcome is CONTRADICTED: citation or attribute mismatches found by the source check, contradictory rule dispositions, and contradictions recorded by F1. Several may describe one underlying conflict (see the root-cause registry).
counts.can_overlap: one conflict may appear as rule findings and as recorded contradictions

decisions_vs_findings.explanation: Blocking decisions and blocking findings are different universes. Each blocking decision appears in the scope either as its own finding (agent, consolidation, scope and unaddressed-gap decisions) or through the item it reviews. Findings without a decision (rules, contradictions, coverage, packets, dependencies) add to the finding count; items blocked only through another decision repeat that decision's effect on a second subject.

rows.label: canonical rules in scope (including cross-batch conflicts)
items with missing or unresolved source references
program scope decisions and packet completion

g2_check_table.explanation: Check rows are overlapping views of the same findings, so their sum exceeds the number of distinct blocking findings; findings counted by no row are listed explicitly.
